name: webnak
description: Host and edit websites with Webnak: create sites from templates, files or GitHub, publish them, change their content and connect custom domains.

interface.longDescription:
Webnak is web hosting with a visual website editor built in. Connect it to ChatGPT to build, publish and update websites by asking, on a free name.webnak.site address or your own domain.

What you can do:
- Create a website in one conversation: start from a designed template, have ChatGPT write the site's files, or host a GitHub repository (built automatically when it needs a build). It is live on HTTPS within seconds.
- Change content without touching code: update headlines, text, links and images on any page, then publish. Or get a private link that opens the visual editor on your live site, so you can click and edit it yourself.
- Edit files directly: list, read, write and delete a site's files, then publish the changes as one deploy.
- Deploy safely: every deploy is kept. Check build status and logs, and roll back to an earlier version in one step.
- Connect your own domain: add a domain, get the exact DNS records to set, and check DNS and HTTPS until it is live.

Who it is for: small businesses, freelancers and agencies who want a website online and kept up to date without a developer, and developers who want hosting they can drive from ChatGPT.

How it works: you sign in with your Webnak account and approve access on a Webnak consent screen. ChatGPT then acts with exactly your permissions and your plan's limits. You can disconnect it at any time in Settings > Sessions in the Webnak dashboard.

Limitations: a free Webnak account is needed (no card). Custom domains need the Starter plan. Hosting a GitHub repository needs GitHub connected in the Webnak dashboard first. Files sent in one request are limited to 10 MB; larger sites can be uploaded with the Webnak CLI or dashboard. Deleting a site is done in the Webnak dashboard, not through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Make a website for my bakery from a Webnak template and put it online.
Change the homepage headline on my Webnak site and publish it.
Connect my domain to my Webnak site and tell me which DNS records to add.
